audit.description: The changed production file casanova/http.py replaces import urllib3 with import requests and meaningfully uses the target API through requests.get(url, **request_kwargs), returning response.raw. Static and dynamic evidence show no urllib3 imports or namespace access from production repo code; the only urllib3 import attempts come from requests' installed dependency code outside the repo. The target requests module resolves to site-packages, and target_local_spec_count is 0, so there is no evidence of a local fake requests provider.
evidence: Unified diff: casanova/http.py changes import urllib3 to import requests and changes pool_manager.request(...) to requests.get(url, **request_kwargs)
Static anti-cheat: casanova/http.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, dynamic_imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false
Dynamic anti-cheat: first target_import from repo is casanova/http.py line 8 with origin site-packages/requests/__init__.py
Dynamic anti-cheat: source_imports_from_production_repo_count=0 and source_imports_from_repo_count=0; source imports are only from dependency files under site-packages/requests
reasons: casanova/http.py imports and calls the real requests package
No changed production code imports or accesses urllib3 directly or dynamically
No local requests shim/provider was detected
